title: Carrying in place-value multiplication

explanation.default: When a place-value column sum is 10 or more, write the units digit and pass the tens as a carry into the next higher place. Carries are ordinary place-value bookkeeping, not a separate mysterious rule.
explanation.beginner: If a column makes 14, write 4 and remember 1 for the next column.
explanation.intermediate: In Urdhva, each vertical/crosswise sweep is one place-value column plus any incoming carry.
explanation.advanced: Carrying is reduction modulo 10 with quotient moved one power of ten higher.

misconceptions.observable_error: Writing raw column products side-by-side without carrying
misconceptions.correct_concept: Each column contributes one digit after carry normalization
misconceptions.teaching_intervention: Replay one Urdhva column and show write_digit vs outgoing_carry
misconceptions.rabbit_hint_strategy: Level 2: watch the carry arrow; do not state the digit yet
misconceptions.follow_up_practice: Urdhva beginner with a mid-size cross product
